one_liner: A to-do list that a new user can sign up for and use in under a minute, on phone or desktop.

items.title: Fresh clone boots with no manual steps
acceptance: Given a fresh clone of the repo, when ./.finish/init.sh runs, then it exits 0 and GET / returns 200

verify.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q . "$d/rc" && cd "$d/rc" && ./.finish/init.sh && curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/

items.title: New user signs up and reaches an empty dashboard
acceptance: Given a new email, when the user completes signup, then they land on /dashboard
Given an already-registered email, when the user signs up, then an inline error is shown and no account is created
Given a signed-up user, when they reload /dashboard, then they are still signed in

items.title: User adds their first task and it persists
acceptance: Given a signed-in user with no tasks, when they open /dashboard, then an empty state invites them to add a task
Given a signed-in user, when they add a task titled 'Buy milk', then it appears at the top of the list
Given a task was added, when the user reloads the page, then the task is still listed
Given the tasks API returns 500, when the user adds a task, then an error message is shown and the typed text is kept

items.title: Returning user logs back in and finds their tasks
acceptance: Given a user with tasks, when they log out, then they land on / and /dashboard redirects to /login
Given a logged-out user with tasks, when they log in with the right password, then their tasks are listed
Given a logged-out user, when they log in with a wrong password, then an inline error is shown and they stay on /login

items.title: User resets a forgotten password by email
acceptance: Given a registered email, when the user requests a reset, then a reset email arrives in Mailpit within 10 seconds
Given a reset link, when the user sets a new password, then they can log in with it and not with the old one
Given a used or expired reset link, when the user opens it, then an error explains the link is no longer valid

items.title: Production build succeeds
acceptance: Given a clean install, when the production build runs, then it exits 0 with no type errors

items.title: P0 screens are responsive and accessible
acceptance: Given each P0 screen, when it loads at 375x812 and at 1440x900, then nothing overflows horizontally and no control is clipped
Given each P0 screen, when axe runs, then it reports no serious or critical violations

items.title: No leaked secrets, no critical dependency vulnerabilities, env documented
acceptance: Given the full git history, when gitleaks scans it, then it reports no leaks
Given the lockfile, when the dependency audit runs, then it reports no critical vulnerabilities
Given the source, when every environment variable it reads is listed, then each one appears in .env.example

verify.command: gitleaks git --no-banner && npm audit --audit-level=critical --omit=dev && node scripts/check-env-example.mjs

items.title: P0 journeys pass on a deployed preview
acceptance: Given the preview URL in .finish/PREVIEW_URL, when the P0 journey specs run against it, then they all pass

verify.command: BASE_URL="$(cat .finish/PREVIEW_URL)" npx playwright test -c e2e/finish/playwright.config.ts J-

items.title: Dark mode follows the system setting
acceptance: Given the OS prefers dark, when the user opens /dashboard, then the dark theme is applied with readable contrast

items.title: Tasks with due dates sync to Google Calendar
acceptance: Given a connected Google account, when the user adds a task with a due date, then a matching calendar event is created
